e3_why: DEVIATION D2 from 'offsets bracketing the predicted certificate transition': under the frozen sound bounds the pairwise static certificate transition lies at 7-9 m clearance, but with a fixed global 6 m lattice an attacker slot cannot be moved to increase its clearance to ALL honest neighbours (lattice sites such as ids 1 and 4 have four neighbours at 6 m: any shift reduces some clearance; the first development sweep shifted AWAY and the realised minimum clearance fell, output/research/coupled_safety_v1/dev_e3_away_sweep_discarded.csv). E3 therefore shifts the attacker slot TOWARD its nearest honest neighbour (the encounter victim) by 0,1,2,3 m (initial clearance to the victim 6,5,4,3 m; yard envelope allows <= 3 m): the certificate is predicted infeasible at all four, so E3 tests the physical 1-D diagnostic M against measured outcomes, not a certificate transition.
